description: Change a game's alerts: turn rules on or off (crashes: more players crash than usual; new_error: a new error spreading; release: the newest version worse than the one before; quiet: the game went quiet; store: a store limit that cuts visibility; plan: the plan's play sessions running out), the weekly summary, email to the workspace's members, the env alerts count ("" for any), remove the webhook, or send a test alert to every channel. Only what you pass changes. A webhook URL can't be added here: the person pastes it in Settings → Alerts, as it's a secret. To stop the weekly summary listing one finding, use glitchless_mark_known instead of turning it off. Ask the person before changing their alerts. Needs an Owner's or Admin's key.

email.description: Email every active member of the workspace

env.description: Count only sessions from this env (as the game passes it to init, e.g. "prod"); "" for any

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

remove_webhook.description: Remove the Discord or Slack webhook

rules.description: Rules to turn on (true) or off (false); the rest stay as they are

crashes.description: more players crash in the last 6 hours than usual for those hours

plan.description: the plan's play sessions for the month reach 80% and 100%

quiet.description: the game went quiet (and a note when sessions are back)

release.description: the newest version stutters or crashes for more players than the one before

store.description: a store limit that cuts the game's visibility (Google Play's bad-behaviour thresholds)

test.description: Then send a test alert to every channel, to check they arrive

weekly.description: The weekly summary on Mondays: how the week went and the findings worth fixing

name: glitchless_set_alerts
title: Change alerts
